question.text: What is the minimum experience required of an independent valuer in the valuation of unlisted securities to be eligible for engagement by a Cat I/II AIF?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per PDF Section 11.12: 'The independent valuer shall have at least 3 years of experience in valuation of unlisted securities.' This is a bright-line minimum. **The Trap:** 1/2 years understate; 5 years overstates (it's the norm for statutory auditor firm rotation, which is a different framework). 3 years is the SEBI-specified floor. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C and XIX-A both test the same minimum. IBBI Registered Valuer rules under Companies Act Sec 247 have separate work-experience norms (typically more onerous). **Manager's Pro-Tip:** When shortlisting valuers, ask for a 3-year engagement history summary — list of Cat I/II AIFs served, asset classes covered, and any SEBI adverse remarks. This due diligence will save you scrambling during SEBI inspections.
